description: Comprehensive catalog of every distinct visual technique across all 28 reference sites. Each technique includes source implementations, vibe tags, and section compatibility. Used by the creative director for intentional, transparent design selection.

techniques.name: Fade-Up on Scroll
techniques.description: Elements fade in and translate upward when they enter the viewport. The foundational animation used on nearly every reference site.
techniques.codeSignature: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }}, whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}, viewport: { once: true, margin: "-60px" }, transition: { duration: 0.6, ease: [0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94] }

techniques.name: Staggered Children Grid
techniques.description: Card grids animate sequentially with incremental delays (0.07-0.15s per item). Creates a cascade effect.

techniques.name: Hero Title Staggered Reveal
techniques.description: Hero headline, subtext, and CTA animate in sequence with varying delays (0.15-0.7s) and distances (20-50px). Each element has different duration for natural feel.
techniques.codeSignature: <motion.h1 initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, delay: 0.3 }} />

techniques.name: Word-by-Word Text Reveal
techniques.description: Each word in a sentence fades in sequentially (0.06s delay per word). Creates an impactful reading experience for mission statements.
techniques.codeSignature: initial={{ opacity: 0.12 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1 }}, transition={{ delay: i * 0.06 }}

techniques.name: Word-by-Word Blur + Fade
techniques.description: Each word fades in with blur filter removing (10px→0) plus y-translate. More dramatic than standard word reveal. Used in Bamzi's hero.
techniques.codeSignature: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40, filter: 'blur(10px)' }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: 'blur(0px)' }}, transition={{ delay: 0.4 + i * 0.13 }}

techniques.name: Typewriter Text Effect
techniques.description: Text reveals character-by-character with blinking cursor on viewport entry. 35ms interval per character. Creates intimate, personal feel.

techniques.name: Line-by-Line Slide Up
techniques.description: Each line of hero heading wraps in overflow:hidden div, text slides up from 100% y to 0. Staggered delays 0.3s, 0.45s, 0.6s. Very dramatic, cinematic.

techniques.name: Animated Number Counter
techniques.description: Numbers count from 0 to target on viewport entry using useMotionValue + animate(). 1.5-2s duration with easeOut. For business metrics like '25 Years' or '2000+ Projects'.
techniques.codeSignature: const controls = animate(count, target, { duration: 2, ease: [0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94], onUpdate: v => setDisplayValue(Math.round(v)) })

techniques.name: Accordion Expand/Collapse
techniques.description: FAQ/service items expand with height 0→auto + opacity animation. Chevron rotates 180° on toggle. 0.3-0.4s duration.
techniques.codeSignature: animate={{ height: open ? 'auto' : 0, opacity: open ? 1 : 0 }} + <ChevronDown className={open ? 'rotate-180' : ''} />

techniques.name: Rotating Testimonials Carousel
techniques.description: Testimonials positioned in circular arrangement, rotate on auto-timer or manual controls. Each card fades in from x:30.
techniques.codeSignature: animate={{ rotate: activeIndex * (360 / count) }} OR initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 30 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}

techniques.name: 3D Perspective Card Carousel
techniques.description: Cards arranged with perspective:1200px, positioned absolutely with rotateY and z-depth. Creates immersive 3D browsing effect.
techniques.codeSignature: perspective: 1200px on container, animate={{ rotateY, z }} per card

techniques.name: Scale-In on Scroll
techniques.description: Elements scale from 0.95 to 1.0 while fading in on viewport entry. Subtler than fade-up, good for galleries and images.
techniques.codeSignature: initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}, whileInView={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}

techniques.name: Floating Decorative Elements
techniques.description: SVG decorative elements (leaves, shapes) float with CSS animation-delay offsets. Adds organic, natural movement to backgrounds.

techniques.name: Scroll Hint Bounce Indicator
techniques.description: Small dot or line bounces vertically inside rounded container to indicate scrollability. Infinite loop, 1.5-2s duration.
techniques.codeSignature: animate={{ y: [0, 12, 0] }}, transition={{ duration: 1.5, repeat: Infinity }}

techniques.name: Continuous Rotation Element
techniques.description: Icon or element rotates 360° continuously over 20s. Creates ambient motion without user interaction.
techniques.codeSignature: animate={{ rotate: 360 }}, transition={{ duration: 20, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' }}

techniques.name: Scroll-Linked Parallax Hero
techniques.description: Hero image/content transforms based on scroll position using useScroll + useTransform. Scale 1→1.15, opacity 1→0 as user scrolls past. Creates depth and cinematic feel.
techniques.codeSignature: const { scrollYProgress } = useScroll({ target: ref, offset: ['start start', 'end start'] }); const scale = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], [1, 1.15]); const opacity = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 0.8], [1, 0]);

techniques.name: Sticky Section with Scroll-Positioned Cards
techniques.description: Full-height container (N * 100vh) with sticky inner. Cards slide in from bottom (y:300→0) based on scroll position with opacity, scale, and z-index transforms. Used for services/process sections.
techniques.codeSignature: style={{ height: `${items.length * 100}vh` }} + <div className='sticky top-0 h-screen'> + useTransform(scrollProgress, [startShow, endShow], [300, 0])

techniques.name: Scroll-Driven Character Reveal
techniques.description: Text reveals character-by-character linked to scroll position (not timing). Each character becomes visible as user scrolls through the section.

techniques.name: Scroll-Driven Story Reveal
techniques.description: Story phrases reveal progressively as user scrolls. Each phrase fades in, holds, then fades out. Container height = phrases * 60vh. Creates cinematic storytelling.
techniques.codeSignature: style={{ height: `${phrases.length * 60}vh` }} + sticky top-0 h-screen + useTransform for opacity/y per phrase

techniques.name: Scroll-Driven Reason/Feature Display
techniques.description: Sticky section reveals one reason/feature at a time as user scrolls through multiple viewport heights. Left side shows progress dots, right side shows content.
techniques.codeSignature: height: reasons.length * 100vh + sticky + activeIndex = Math.floor(scrollYProgress * reasons.length)

techniques.name: Scroll-Following Product Icon
techniques.description: Fixed product icon moves with scroll position (y, x, rotate, scale, opacity all linked to scroll). Creates a playful element that follows the user.
techniques.codeSignature: y = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 0.15, 0.35, 0.5], [100, -20, -100, -200]) + fixed top-1/2 left-1/2 pointer-events-none

techniques.name: Scroll-Linked Blur Reveal
techniques.description: Image starts blurred (20px) and clears as user scrolls. Combined with scale (1.1→1) and opacity (0.7→1). Creates premium reveal effect.

techniques.name: Sticky Hero Scale Shrink
techniques.description: Hero section stays sticky while scaling down (1→0.85) and fading out (1→0) as user scrolls past. Content behind is revealed.

techniques.name: Expanding Footer on Scroll
techniques.description: Footer scales from 0.9→1 and border-radius from 48px→0 as user scrolls to bottom. Creates satisfying page-end reveal.

techniques.name: 3D Card Scroll Animation
techniques.description: Portfolio cards appear from below with 3D rotation (15°), scale (0.4→1), and alternating x-offset based on scroll position. Dramatic reveal for project showcases.

techniques.name: Expanding Circle Section Transition
techniques.description: Circle expands from center (scale 0→60) as user scrolls through transition area. Creates dramatic section boundary.

techniques.name: Product Rotation on Scroll
techniques.description: Product image rotates 0→360° on Y-axis with scale pulse (0.8→1→0.8) as user scrolls. Perfect for product showcases.

techniques.name: Scroll-Linked Step Image Reveal
techniques.description: Step/process images fade in and scale (1.1→1) linked to scroll position over each card. Creates progressive reveal as user reads each step.

techniques.name: Floating 3D Geometric Shapes
techniques.description: Geometric shapes float upward with scroll-linked y, opacity, and scale transforms. 3 shapes with staggered start positions create depth.

techniques.name: Infinite Horizontal Marquee
techniques.description: Content scrolls infinitely left at constant speed. Items duplicated for seamless loop. 25-40s duration, pauses on hover. Used for testimonials, logos, service names.
techniques.codeSignature: animate={{ x: ['0%', '-50%'] }}, transition={{ duration: 30, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' }} OR CSS: animation: marquee-scroll 35s linear infinite;

techniques.name: Opposing-Direction Image Marquees
techniques.description: Two rows of image cards scroll in opposite directions (left and right). Creates dynamic visual energy.
techniques.codeSignature: .marquee-left { animation: scroll-left 30s linear infinite; } .marquee-right { animation: scroll-right 30s linear infinite; }

techniques.name: Rotating Question/Tag Rows
techniques.description: Multiple rows of text pills scrolling in alternating directions at different speeds. Creates a 'wall of questions/challenges' effect. 3 rows with ticker-left and ticker-right CSS.
techniques.codeSignature: .ticker-left { animation: ticker-left 25s linear infinite; } .ticker-right { animation: ticker-right 30s linear infinite; }

techniques.name: Large Flowing Background Marquee
techniques.description: Extra-large semi-transparent text (5-9rem) flows as marquee behind content. Creates depth layer with text at 4% opacity.

techniques.name: Vertical Feed Scroll
techniques.description: Content scrolls vertically inside a fixed-height container. Creates activity feed or customer notification feel.
techniques.codeSignature: h-[200px] overflow-hidden + .vertical-scroll { animation: scroll-y 15s linear infinite; }

techniques.name: CSS Columns Masonry Gallery
techniques.description: Photos arranged in responsive CSS columns (not grid) with break-inside-avoid. Items have varying aspect ratios for organic masonry feel. 1→2→3 columns responsive.
techniques.codeSignature: <div className='columns-1 sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3 gap-4 space-y-4'> + className='break-inside-avoid'

techniques.name: Split Two-Column Hero
techniques.description: Hero divided into text (left) and image/visual (right) in a 2-column grid. Balanced, professional composition.

techniques.name: Overlapping Sections with Z-Index Cascade
techniques.description: Sections use negative margins (-mt-1 to -mt-6) and increasing z-index to create a stacked card effect. Each section visually overlaps the previous one with rounded-t-[2rem].

techniques.name: Grid with Offset Row Heights
techniques.description: Cards in a grid have staggered marginTop (i * 24px) creating visual rhythm with uneven heights. Breaks the rigid grid feel.

techniques.name: Circular Image Containers
techniques.description: Images displayed in perfect circles (rounded-full) or near-circles. Creates unique, appetizing or personal presentation.

techniques.name: Split Menu/Catalog Layout
techniques.description: Two-column layout: left side has huge title + list items, right side has full image. Used for restaurant menus, service catalogs.
techniques.codeSignature: grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-16 + space-y-0 with border-b items

techniques.name: Transitional Color-Split Section
techniques.description: 50/50 split of two background colors with centered circular image overlapping both. Creates visual transition between sections.
techniques.codeSignature: <div className='bg-cream h-[180px]' /><div className='bg-dark h-[180px]' /> + absolute centered circle overlapping both

techniques.name: Schedule/Table Grid Layout
techniques.description: Structured data displayed in 4-column grid table with header row, grouped by day/category. Hover changes row background color.
techniques.codeSignature: grid grid-cols-4 gap-4 px-6 py-3 + hover:bg-[var(--brand-bg-alt)] transition-colors

techniques.name: Highlighted Middle Pricing Tier
techniques.description: 3-tier pricing where middle tier is visually emphasized with different background, scale(1.02), ring-2, and color inversion.

techniques.name: Gallery with Featured First Item
techniques.description: First gallery item spans 2 columns and 2 rows (col-span-2 row-span-2), remaining items are standard aspect-[4/3]. Creates visual hierarchy.

techniques.name: Horizontal Data Rows Layout
techniques.description: Items displayed as wide horizontal rows with custom grid columns (number, title, detail, time). Divided by borders. Good for classes, services, menus.

techniques.name: Staggered Image Heights in Grid
techniques.description: 3-column image grid where columns have different heights (380px, 520px, 380px). Creates dynamic visual rhythm.

techniques.name: Gallery Collage with Auto-Flow Grid
techniques.description: Items flow naturally in CSS Grid with auto-fill and varying sizes. Creates organic collage feel for camp/event photos.

techniques.name: Floating Stat Card
techniques.description: Card positioned absolutely at negative offset (-bottom-6 -left-6) with shadow-2xl, floating above adjacent content.

techniques.name: Glassmorphism Comparison Table
techniques.description: Semi-transparent table with backdrop-blur and gradient borders. Rows highlight on hover. Used for 'us vs them' comparisons.

techniques.name: Image Zoom on Hover
techniques.description: Image scales 1.05-1.10x on card hover with 500-700ms transition. The universal hover effect for image cards.

techniques.name: Card Shadow Elevation on Hover
techniques.description: Card gains deeper shadow on hover. Creates a 'lifting' tactile feel.

techniques.name: Card Lift on Hover
techniques.description: Card moves up 4px (-translate-y-1) on hover creating a physical lift effect. Combined with shadow.

techniques.name: Gallery Image Overlay + Label Reveal
techniques.description: On hover: image scales 1.05x AND dark overlay (0→40% opacity) appears with label text sliding up. Three simultaneous effects.
techniques.codeSignature: group-hover:scale-105 + bg-black/0 group-hover:bg-black/40 + opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 translate-y-2 group-hover:translate-y-0

techniques.name: Icon Background Opacity Shift
techniques.description: Service card icon background changes opacity (10%→20%) on card hover. Subtle, professional.

techniques.name: Button Arrow Gap Expansion
techniques.description: CTA button with arrow icon — gap between text and arrow increases on hover (gap-2→gap-3). Arrow slides further out.

techniques.name: Mix-Blend-Difference Custom Cursor
techniques.description: Fixed red/colored circle follows mouse position with mix-blend-difference. Inverts background colors wherever cursor is positioned. Cinematic, editorial.
techniques.codeSignature: fixed w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-red-600 mix-blend-difference pointer-events-none + onMouseMove tracking

techniques.name: Mix-Blend-Difference Navbar
techniques.description: Fixed navbar uses mix-blend-difference so text always contrasts with background regardless of section color. No need for scroll-aware color changes.

techniques.name: Arrow Icon Reveal on Hover
techniques.description: Arrow icon appears in bottom-right of card on hover with opacity transition. Indicates clickability.

techniques.name: Card Background Color Shift on Hover
techniques.description: Card background color darkens or lightens on hover (e.g., from #1B4332 to #2D6A4F).

techniques.name: Cards Slide In from Left/Right
techniques.description: Service cards slide in from -40px (left) or 40px (right) alternating by index. Creates dynamic visual flow.
techniques.codeSignature: initial={{ opacity: 0, x: i % 2 === 0 ? -40 : 40 }}, whileInView={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}

techniques.name: Fluid Clamp Typography
techniques.description: Headings use CSS clamp() for fluid sizing. Responsive without breakpoints. Typically clamp(2.5rem, 5-7vw, 4.5-6.5rem) with tight tracking (-0.02 to -0.04em).

techniques.name: Serif Display Font
techniques.description: Serif font for display headings creating premium, editorial, or luxury feel. Uses font-[family-name:var(--font-display)].

techniques.name: Italic Accent in Headlines
techniques.description: Specific words in headline are italic (and sometimes in accent color). Creates emphasis and personality. Often used for business descriptor.

techniques.name: Uppercase Tracked Section Labels
techniques.description: Section labels in tiny uppercase text with wide letter spacing. Creates editorial hierarchy above main headings.

techniques.name: Monospace for Metadata
techniques.description: Phone numbers, hours, addresses, and other structured data displayed in monospace font. Creates technical, organized feel.

techniques.name: Giant Brand Typography
techniques.description: Extremely large brand name text: clamp(6rem, 20vw, 18-20rem). Fills the viewport width. Creates immediate brand impact.

techniques.name: Single Colored Accent Word
techniques.description: One word in a headline rendered in brand accent color. Draws eye to key descriptor.

techniques.name: Font-Light Elegant Headings
techniques.description: Section headings use font-light (300 weight) instead of bold for elegant, minimal feel. Combined with large fluid sizing.

techniques.name: Serif Italic Full Display
techniques.description: All major headings use italic serif font. Creates warm, personal, appetizing feel. Signature look for food/lifestyle brands.

techniques.name: Film Grain Noise Overlay
techniques.description: SVG turbulence noise pattern layered over sections with mix-blend-mode. Creates warm, analog, cinematic feel at 3-6% opacity.
techniques.codeSignature: body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; inset: 0; background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,...turbulence...'); mix-blend-mode: hard-light; opacity: 0.04; }

techniques.name: Dot Pattern Background
techniques.description: Radial gradient dots at low opacity (0.08) create subtle texture. 40px spacing. Works on both light and dark backgrounds.

techniques.name: Glassmorphism Effect
techniques.description: Semi-transparent background (white/10-90) with backdrop-blur creating frosted glass effect. Used on navbars, cards, overlays.

techniques.name: Multi-Layer Gradient Overlays
techniques.description: Stacked gradient layers on hero images: bg-gradient-to-t, bg-gradient-to-r, bg-black/20. Controls readability and mood.
techniques.codeSignature: <div className='absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/70 via-black/20 to-transparent' /> + <div className='absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-black/60 to-transparent' />

techniques.name: Particle Field Background
techniques.description: 200 radial-gradient circles creating nebula/star field. Center-biased positioning. Deep space aesthetic for tech/SaaS.
techniques.codeSignature: Array.from({length: 200}).map(() => radial-gradient dot at random position, center-biased)

techniques.name: Sky Gradient with Cloud Layers
techniques.description: Multi-stop linear gradient (blue→cream) with overlapping radial gradients simulating clouds. Dreamy, soft aesthetic.
techniques.codeSignature: .sky-gradient { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #d4e4f0, #b8cfe4, ..., #f0ebe4); } + .cloud-layer with multiple radial-gradient ellipses

techniques.name: Decorative SVG Geometric Shapes
techniques.description: Custom SVG circles, triangles, and dots positioned absolutely at low opacity. Outlines only (not filled). Creates playful, branded visual texture.

techniques.name: Decorative Leaf/Nature SVGs
techniques.description: Large semi-transparent leaf outlines + SVG curved wave transition between sections. Nature-themed decorative elements.
techniques.codeSignature: <ellipse cx='100' cy='200' rx='80' ry='180' fill='var(--brand-primary)' opacity='0.3' /> + <path d='M0,120 L0,60 Q720,0 1440,60 L1440,120 Z' />

techniques.name: Floating Background Glow Orbs
techniques.description: Large blurred circles (600px, blur-[120px]) positioned absolutely at 10-15% opacity. Creates atmospheric depth behind content.
techniques.codeSignature: w-[600px] h-[600px] bg-[#3B82F6]/10 rounded-full blur-[120px] absolute

techniques.name: Radial Gradient Dappled Light
techniques.description: Multiple radial gradient ellipses simulating dappled light through trees/windows. Creates natural, organic atmosphere.

techniques.name: Grid Pattern Overlay
techniques.description: CSS linear gradients creating a subtle grid pattern (60px cells) at very low opacity (0.03). Adds structure without being visible.

techniques.name: Gradient Connecting Line
techniques.description: Horizontal line with gradient opacity between process steps. Fades from 20% to 40% to 20%. Visually connects related elements.

techniques.name: Video Background Hero
techniques.description: Autoplay muted looping video as hero background with gradient overlay for text readability. Cinematic, high-impact.
techniques.codeSignature: <video autoPlay muted loop playsInline className='absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover' /> + gradient overlay divs

techniques.name: Aspect Ratio Image Containers
techniques.description: Images wrapped in fixed aspect ratio containers (4/3, 3/4, 16/10, square) with overflow-hidden and rounded corners. Ensures consistent layout.

techniques.name: Gradient Placeholder Images
techniques.description: When real images unavailable, use brand-colored gradients as placeholders. Each card gets a unique gradient direction/color combo.

techniques.name: Nested Concentric Circle Borders
techniques.description: Multiple concentric circles (90%, 80% width) with thin borders creating plate/presentation effect around circular images.
techniques.codeSignature: <div className='absolute inset-0 w-[90%] h-[90%] rounded-full border' /> nested

techniques.name: Specs/Info Overlay on Image
techniques.description: Small dark semi-transparent cards with icon + text positioned over product image showing specs (speed, power, etc).
techniques.codeSignature: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-lg px-3 py-2 + absolute positioned over image

techniques.name: Feature/New Badge on Card
techniques.description: Small pill badge ('New', 'Featured', 'Popular') positioned absolutely in top-left/right of card image.
techniques.codeSignature: absolute top-4 left-4 bg-white text-black text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full

techniques.name: Process Step with Number Circle + Ghost Number
techniques.description: Large faded number (text-6xl, opacity 5%) in corner as decorative element, plus small accent-colored circle with step number. Dual number display.
techniques.codeSignature: {n} +

techniques.name: Circular Logo Badge in Navbar
techniques.description: Circular badge in navbar extending below nav bar (-mb-4) with stacked text. Creates unique brand mark without logo image.
techniques.codeSignature: w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-[var(--brand-accent)] -mb-4 z-10 + text-[9px] font-extrabold uppercase

techniques.name: Globe with Rotating Grid Lines
techniques.description: SVG circle with animated grid lines that rotate based on active process step. Lines positioned at percentage offsets (16.6% intervals).

techniques.name: Comparison Table with Check/X Icons

techniques.name: Live Clock in Navbar
techniques.description: Real-time clock updating every second in navbar. Shows timezone. Adds dynamic, editorial feel.

techniques.name: Large Faded Letter as Section Divider
techniques.description: Large letter (A, B, C, D) at 20% opacity as visual anchor for service sections. Creates editorial, magazine-like feel.

techniques.name: Testimonial Cards with Slash+Number
techniques.description: Large '/' and number in top-left of each testimonial card at 10% opacity. Creates editorial feel to reviews.

techniques.name: Blog Card with Metadata Bar
techniques.description: Blog cards with date, category, author in tiny uppercase tracking-widest text above the title.

techniques.name: Quote with Accent Line Above

techniques.name: Nature Icon Badge for Popular Tier

techniques.description: Dashed border container that lightens on hover. Good for file upload areas, optional form fields, or interactive zones.
